# Hondabase

> Hondabase (www.hondabase.com) is a community-driven, GitHub-preserved technical
> knowledgebase for Honda and Acura vehicles: wiring diagrams, ECU references,
> engine swaps, diagnostics, maintenance guides and known issues, organized by
> product line (cars, motorcycles, engines, aircraft) down to model, generation
> and engine family.

Content is available in English (unprefixed URLs) and Portuguese (/pt/...).
Articles are reviewed by the community before publication and every revision is
tracked in a public git repository.

## Key resources

- Sitemap (all indexable pages): https://www.hondabase.com/sitemap.xml
- Latest articles (Atom): https://www.hondabase.com/feed.xml
- Source content (Markdown, forkable): https://github.com/hondabase/articles
- Search: https://www.hondabase.com/explore
